notes:
Version 2.3.0.1 — Game recording hotfix

Fixes untimed games failing to record with an Invalid timer mode response.
End & Record now has winner and win-type selectors like the web client,
scrollable optional details, visible errors, and recording progress.
Winner selections survive live state updates, and repeated taps while saving
are ignored. New games preserve the actual starting player across recovery;
older games allow choosing it rather than assuming the first seat.
